detail.note: transport CLEARED end-to-end (install+inference reached); AgentTimeoutError@1200s; small task (<32k), measures bare competence not overflow. arm B (decomposition transport) does not exist -> no proxied comparison possible yet.

HONEST overflow floor. Key authenticated (errors 0), real tool-use turns occurred, then context crossed 32k. This is the failure the proxy exists to prevent, not a transport/auth artifact (contrast armA-smoke 401). est task ctx ~112k tok; bare 32k model cannot stay in-window.
detail.errorMessage: Maximum context length 32768 tokens; prompt has 40814 tokens, exceeds by 8046

detail.note: SOLVED. 160 turns, 117 toolUse + 43 stop, clean agentic loop. NO 32k overflow. Bare 32k model completes a hard agentic task within cap.
FAILED via AgentTimeoutError at 15min cap. 224 turns (149 toolUse + 75 stop), NO 32k context overflow. Speed/capability limit, not context.

FAILED (wrong answer), NO overflow. Ended with pi compaction_start(reason:threshold) — pi's OWN context management fired BEFORE the 32k hard limit. Evidence that pi's built-in transport absorbs context pressure.
